meta.title: Agnes Model Access
meta.description: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.
